inference: The FAIL ledger the suite read was written by an invocation of product/cycle_verify.py --write against a results/product/regression/ tree that predated 39060279436 (the only trees whose newest artifact can produce the recorded claim pair), i.e. not against this cycle's own measurement. The ledger bytes are not in the snapshot - the workflow's Persist team snapshot step commits every untracked file, so a file present at persist time would be committed - therefore the FAIL file was removed before the snapshot was persisted. Both halves are consistent with a producer that generated a FAIL ledger early, watched the suite go red on its own newest-ledger assertion, and then could not escape the fixed point inside its remaining quantum.
